mentions.name: snakemake-executor-plugin-aws-basic-batch
mentions.description: An experimental, not yet fully working Snakemake executor plugin variant for AWS Batch that explores three ideas: relying on existing job definitions managed through IaC instead of dynamic creation, implementing a fire-and-forget model where the main snakemake process also runs on Batch, and slimming down the snakemake container by stripping off unnecessary features.
mentions.source_excerpt: 2) https://github.com/radusuciu/snakemake-executor-plugin-aws-basic-batch/. This is more experimental and not yet fully working. I wanted to try a few things. a) can we rely on existing job definitions (managed through IaC instead). b) can we implement a fire-and-forget model where the main snakemake process runs on Batch as well? c) Can we slim down the snakemake container by stripping off unnecessary features.
